metadata.new_description: Comprehensive review of cslib PR #648 (https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/648). This task serves as the central tracking point for all review dimensions: upstream reviewer feedback, architectural concerns, API design decisions, compatibility with existing Propositional/ and Hilbert/ developments, naming conventions, and any requested changes. Initial research compared the thomaskwaring/cslib_SKI Hilbert branch approach against the PR's Hilbert system design; further research rounds should address additional review concerns as they arise, including code quality, proof style, module organization, and alignment with cslib contribution standards.
